answer: A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs thus has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator forfeits authoring per alias. Because the summit hash is checked against the gale checkpoint at intake, the willow audit keeps the value, and a stale hash burns the key its whole submission. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 8 epochs. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
